items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Budd, I'd just like to mention here right now, for the record's sake, that (Esa Sayeehee) was a white Haitian. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, actually he's Arabic background.

ctx.x: Now to -- to -- to say what, tell you what he told me, I was the first jazz musician to go down to Haiti and instruct the musicians and play with them.
Budd, I'd just like to mention here right now, for the record's sake, that (Esa Sayeehee) was a white Haitian.
